svg.title: From your fork to a pull request that merges cleanly
svg.desc: How to contribute to alexander-kastil/claude-harness from the fork aeshilion/claude-harness. Three lanes, top to bottom: the upstream repo on GitHub, the fork on GitHub (origin), and the local clone on your machine. The animation plays steps 1 to 9 in order and shows the commits moving between the lanes. Step 6, merging upstream master into the feature branch right before the pull request, is the step that avoids conflicts. Step 8 loops back to it while the pull request is open. A fourth row names the Claude Code command that runs each step: /ext-contribute-setup for steps 1 and 2, start for 3 and 4, /ext-sideload to try step 5 in VS Code, sync for 6 and 8, pr for 7 and finish for 9.
svg.text: From your fork to a pull request that merges cleanly
